name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST Twice, Course Code Changed
description: POSTs the same apprenticeship learner (ULN 44444448) twice with no ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent in between. The second POST changes the course (standardCode 21 -> 30), same UKPRN. CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.Handle looks up the existing draft via GetAllByLearnerKey(learner.Key, ukprn, courseCode) — scoped by course code as well as UKPRN — so the second POST's changed course code means the lookup finds no match against the first draft. Unlike apprenticeship-draft-post-twice-startdate-updated (where an unrelated field change on the same course still resolves to the same draft), this is NOT treated as an update: a second, independent unapproved ApprenticeshipLearning row is created for the new course, leaving both drafts in place rather than merging them onto one row.

steps.name: SLD Re-POSTs the Same Learner With a Different Course (standardCode 30)

assertions.name: Two separate ApprenticeshipLearning rows exist for the learner, one per course
The two learnings' episodes carry distinct training codes
